50567.summary: The class discusses Revelation 19, focusing on the marriage of the Lamb and the judgment of Rome. It explores the symbolism of the rainbow angel and the destruction of the Catholic system, emphasizing the involvement of Christadelphians in these future events.

50568.summary: The class discusses the Armies on White Horses in Revelation 19, focusing on the marriage supper of the Lamb and the judgment of the beast and false prophet. It covers the symbolism of the armies, the feast of the nations, and the destruction of the Catholic system.

50569.summary: The class discusses Revelation 20, focusing on the binding of Satan and the events leading to the final judgment. It emphasizes the suppression of carnality during the millennium and the ultimate destruction of evil.

50570.summary: The class discusses Revelation 21:1-8, focusing on the new heaven and earth beyond the millennium when there will be no more death, sorrow, or tears. It emphasizes the final judgment and the eternal state of perfection.

50571.summary: The class discusses Revelation 21, focusing on the New Jerusalem as the fulfillment of the Abrahamic covenant and the divine plan. It emphasizes the role of the Holy Spirit in the development of the ecclesia and the final judgment.

50572.summary: The class focuses on Revelation 21 and 22, emphasizing the role of the Spirit in achieving eternal life and the importance of faith and perseverance. It highlights the symbolism of the New Jerusalem and the River of Life, encouraging believers to seek the Spirit's guidance and to prepare for the coming Kingdom.
